stories.headline: Indian Shares Seen Higher Despite Global Selloff
stories.body: (RTTNews) - Indian shares look set to open higher on Monday despite a sharp sell-off on Wall Street Friday, sparked by an unwinding of the artificial intelligence trade.

stories.headline: How Block is pushing its AI to merchants
stories.body: Jack Dorsey’s payments company spent the better part of the last year using artificial intelligence to reimagine how it operates. Now, Block is making good on its promise to share some of that technology with its sellers on Square.

stories.headline: Wonder Shops Grubhub to Walmart and Other Potential Buyers
stories.body: Wonder is reportedly weighing a sale of Grubhub two years after acquiring the fellow food delivery company. Bankers have been in touch with Walmart, Target, Kroger and other retailers about a possible sale, The Wall Street Journal (WSJ) reported Friday (Nov. 20), citing sources familiar with the matter.
